title: The Clovehitch Killer
description: After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.

title: The Shed
description: A teen and his best friend endure nonstop torment from bullies at school, but that soon changes when one discovers a bloodthirsty creature that resides in a country shed.

title: Feral
description: A wild animal attacks six grad students on a weekend hike in the woods. One by one, they become infected with an unknown virus that turns them into bloodthirsty creatures.

title: Fingerprints
description: A series of murders are linked to the tragic deaths of schoolchildren 50 years earlier.

title: The Dead Room
description: Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.

title: I Trapped the Devil
description: Hoping for a joyful family reunion, Matt and his wife pay a surprise visit to the home of his estranged brother, Steve, to celebrate Christmas. To their shock, they soon learn that Steve has a hostage in his basement -- a man he claims is the devil.

title: Dementia
description: Hired as a live-in nurse, a seemingly sweet woman (Kristina Klebe) unleashes her dark side as she torments a Vietnam War veteran (Gene Jones) who has dementia.

title: Depraved
description: A disillusioned field surgeon who is suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder makes a man out of body parts and brings him to life in a Brooklyn loft.

title: State of Emergency
description: Survivors band together after an explosion at a military bioweapons plant turns most of their neighbors into flesh-eating zombies.

title: Some Kind of Hate
description: Once a victim of vicious bullying, a teenage girl (Sierra McCormick) rises from the grave to punish the tormentors of a new student (Ronen Rubinstein) at a remote school.

title: The Babadook
description: A troubled widow (Essie Davis) discovers that her son is telling the truth about a monster that entered their home through the pages of a children's book.

title: ATM
description: A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.

title: The Invoking
description: Samantha inherits a house from family she never knew and goes to the property with three friends to see it. Shortly after their arrival, Samantha experiences horrific visions as the demons from her past refuse to stay buried.

title: The Invoking 2
description: Waking nightmares, bloodthirsty spirits, demonic forces, and vengeful poltergeists visit horror upon their victims in this anthology.

title: The Power
description: Though two lovers' families are ripped apart for the sake of revenge and power, they rise out of that pit of bloodlust and despair together.

title: The Vigil
description: Terror strikes when an Orthodox Jewish man agrees to watch over the dead body of a community member in a dilapidated Brooklyn home.

title: Inner Demons
description: A reality show crew descends upon the home of a teenager struggling with drug addiction and uncover instead a terrifying case of demonic possession.

title: Pyewacket
description: A frustrated, angst-ridden teenage girl awakens something in the woods when she naively performs an occult ritual to evoke a witch to kill her mother.

title: The Midnight Man
description: A girl plays a game with her friends and summons the creature known as the Midnight Man, who uses their worst fears against them.

title: Baskin

description: A sinister couple hatch a supernatural scheme to resurrect their dead grandson through a pregnant woman.

description: A young woman and a damaged occultist risk their souls to perform a ritual.
